baseline: Highest historical native track_listens in same supported collection excluding whole query component; native-ID ties. Identical candidates retained.

rules.adjudication: Preserve original answers; any adjudication is a separate record.
rules.genre_positive: Both fit and introduction usefulness >=4, exact listening, no unsure/unsupported/conflict; retain other outcomes separately.
rules.identity_error: Quarantine known wrong identity or credits; retain denominator and original response.
rules.neighbors: Separate sonic and cultural preferences; retain tie, neither, unsure, unsupported and disagreement. Identical candidates are nondiscriminating.
rules.operational_complete: Both listeners supply access and rating-or-unsure responses on at least 10/12 items in each task; otherwise incomplete.
rules.promotion: None; no quality score, significance, global coverage or musical acceptance claim.
rules.uncertainty: Descriptive counts only; future uncertainty must cluster native artist/leakage component. Never pool repeated judgments as independent votes.

sampling: Lowest seeded SHA256 per cell: three single/multiple x root/child genres; six default queries per collection, unsupported retained. Genre uses frozen first starter. No replacements.
scope_limits: New protocol/seed, not historical PR18 reconstruction
No balanced cold/heldout sampling or quality inference; model training scope remains the attached pack provenance
No full-catalog, membership, map or global acceptance claim
